title.purpose: Dialog and panel headings — the largest type in the app (20px). No display type above this.

body.purpose: Default UI text, labels, prose (13px, UI face).

label.purpose: Rationed uppercase micro-labels and pills (12px, 0.06em tracking).

data-mono.purpose: Anything the CLI would print — hostnames, interfaces, telnet ports, RAM, config.

chip-mono.purpose: The smallest data face; sits on the cable and grows on hover.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting hairline lift on small controls (Bench).

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Node faces, dialogs, popovers, the hover-popped chip (Bench).

shadows.name: led-glow-running
shadows.purpose: Running-state LED halo (state glows are the primary expressive elevation).

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Hover cues on controls, connector affordance, LED, cable glow.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Default state transitions (theme fade, panel changes).

motion.name: chip-pop
motion.purpose: The PNetLab hover-pop on port chips — a slight spring, never a bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single loud action per bar (e.g. Start lab).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #30455a; background: #151d28; color: #eaf0f7; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #4bc6d1; border-color: #4bc6d1; color: #05161a; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #63d6e0; border-color: #63d6e0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4bc6d1; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard toolbar button; hover shifts the border to the accent (a quiet cue, not a fill change).
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #30455a; background: #151d28; color: #eaf0f7; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #4bc6d1; } .ds-btn-default:active { background: #24333f; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4bc6d1; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Pill-shaped group for the theme switch; active segment fills with the accent.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; background: #151d28; border: 1px solid #30455a; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-seg-btn { font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #7286a0; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { color: #eaf0f7; } .ds-seg-btn.on { background: #4bc6d1; color: #05161a; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Provider/connection state pill with a leading LED dot that recolors and halos by state.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #30455a; color: #a7bacf; background: #151d28; } .ds-led { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #39d98a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #39d98a 22%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field; focus shifts the border to the accent.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; background: #10161f; color: #eaf0f7; border: 1px solid #30455a; border-radius: 5px; padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7286a0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4bc6d1; outline: none; }

components.name: Node Face (signature)
components.description: The 64px device tile: gradient face, centered tintable glyph, mono name chip with a status LED, and a corner connector affordance that surfaces on hover.
components.html: R1
components.css: .ds-node { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; width: 64px; } .ds-node-face { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #131b26, #0e1620); border: 1px solid #30455a; display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); color: #eaf0f7; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-node-face:hover { border-color: #4bc6d1; } .ds-node-connector { all: unset; position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -6px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4bc6d1; color: #05161a; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: crosshair; opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6); transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-node-face:hover .ds-node-connector, .ds-node-connector:focus-visible { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-node-name { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Cascadia Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #eaf0f7; background: color-mix(in oklab, #121a25 92%, #0a0e14); border: 1px solid #223041; border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 7px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-led { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #39d98a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, #39d98a 24%, transparent); }

components.name: Port Chip (signature hover-pop)
components.description: PNetLab-style interface label riding on a cable; scales 1.65x on hover and reveals the full detail. Hover it to see the pop.
components.css: .ds-port-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Cascadia Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; color: #eaf0f7; background: linear-gradient(#121a25, #121a25), #0a0e14; border: 1px solid #223041; border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 5px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: default; transform: scale(1); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2), background 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-chip-detail { display: none; color: #a7bacf; } .ds-port-chip:hover { transform: scale(1.65); background: rgba(21,30,42,0.96); border-color: #4bc6d1; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-port-chip:hover .ds-chip-detail { display: inline; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-port-chip:hover { transform: scale(1.18); } }

narrative.overview: iolbox is a network-lab instrument, and its identity is the duality named in its two themes. Bench is the instrument at rest on a dark workbench — a blue-black slate ground, not pure black, biased toward the accent so it reads as chosen. Glass is the same instrument under studio light — Apple-vibrancy frosted panels floating over a faintly-cool white, the topology reading through the material. One token system, one layout; only the surface treatment changes. The system draws exclusively from the subject's own world: rack equipment, terminal phosphor, LED status indicators, color-coded patch cabling, the monospace CLI. Anything the CLI would print is set in mono; the UI chrome is set in the system UI face. That single split is the signature. The system explicitly rejects the AI-coded default, metrics-dashboard chrome, and the dated heavy feel of the incumbent lab web consoles — borrowing their interactions, never their weight.
keyCharacteristics: Hue-biased neutrals (slate tuned toward the accent), never pure grey or black.
Mono carries the data; the UI face carries the chrome — never one face for all.
Status is an LED with a soft glow (shape + color + label), never a bare word.
One bold move per surface (the accent, or the glass material); everything else quiet.
Tactile & responsive: elements come alive under the cursor, but every motion is functional.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears on ≤10% of any screen. It is spent on selection, focus, the single primary action, and live links — never as decoration. If two things on screen are both accent-colored and neither is selected/active/primary, one is wrong.

rules.name: The LED Rule
rules.body: State is never communicated by text color alone. It is an LED dot with a colored box-shadow halo (plus a pulse for the transitional Starting state), backed by a label. The four state colors are reserved.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: If the value would appear in a CLI — a hostname, an interface, a telnet port, a byte count — it is set in the mono face. If it is chrome, it is set in the UI face. This split is the identity.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A resting panel is defined by its tonal step and its hairline border, not by a shadow. Shadows and glows are earned by state: hover, selection, focus, elevation, or live activity.

dos: Do bias every neutral toward the accent hue — keep neutrals hue-tuned, never pure grey/black.
Do set anything the CLI would print in the Cascadia mono face; set chrome in the Segoe UI Variable face.
Do show state as an LED dot with a colored glow and a label — shape + color + word.
Do ration the accent to ≤10% of a screen: selection, focus, the one primary action, live links.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; let shadow/glow be earned by hover, selection, focus, or live activity.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative — this is a hard requirement.
Do verify AA contrast on both themes; the raised/darkened ink steps exist so muted text still clears 4.5:1.
Do consolidate stacking onto a semantic z-index scale (canvas → topbar → panels → dropdown → dialog → modal → tooltip).
donts: Don't reproduce the AI-coded default: near-black #0d1117, a safe blue accent, rounded generic cards, one neutral sans for everything.
Don't build metrics-dashboard chrome — no hero-number tiles, no identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't let the tool inherit the heavy, dated feel of PNetLab / EVE-NG / CML web consoles.
Don't convey status by a bare colored word with no LED shape behind it.
Don't spend the primary accent on decoration; if two unselected/inactive things are accent-colored, one is wrong.
Don't put a drop-shadow on a static, unselected surface. Flat at rest.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — the Glass blur is load-bearing theme identity on floating panels only.
Don't reach for arbitrary z-index values (1000, 1100, 2000, 3000, 999 !important); use the semantic scale.
Don't ship display type — the scale tops out at 20px on purpose. This is an instrument, not a landing page.
